name: rs3-api-workspace
description: Workspace for the RuneScape 3 plugin TypeScript SDK: rs3-api-core (Jagex API declarations), rs3-api-extended (runtime helpers), rs3-api-prettyui (PrettyUI library declarations) and rs3-api-ts (the rs3-plugin build tool).

scripts.build: npm run build -w rs3-api-extended && npm run build -w rs3-api-ts
scripts.publish:local: npm run build && npm test && node ./scripts/publish-local.js link
